message:
Hey everyone! 😊 We know that family chats can sometimes get a little chaotic, especially when discussing preparedness. That’s why we love the resources over at Ready.gov for kids. They have fun and engaging ways to help our little ones understand safety and what to do in different situations. 

It's a great conversation starter for our family group chats, making sure everyone feels included and informed. What’s your favorite tip for teaching kids about safety? Let's share our ideas!
